title: podman system service crashes: "assignment to entry in nil map" in getImageRootfs
body:
### Issue Description

A multi-stage build sent to the API service (`podman system service`) kills the whole
service process. It happens when one stage fails while a sibling stage is still running and
that sibling later reaches `COPY --from=<external image>`. Every client of the service
loses its connection, and the service stays down unless something restarts it.

```
panic: assignment to entry in nil map

github.com/containers/buildah/imagebuildah.(*StageExecutor).getImageRootfs(...)
	vendor/github.com/containers/buildah/imagebuildah/stage_executor.go:1156
github.com/containers/buildah/imagebuildah.(*StageExecutor).Execute(...)
	vendor/github.com/containers/buildah/imagebuildah/stage_executor.go:1429
github.com/containers/buildah/imagebuildah.(*Executor).buildStage(...)
	vendor/github.com/containers/buildah/imagebuildah/executor.go:619
github.com/containers/buildah/imagebuildah.(*Executor).Build.func3.1()
	vendor/github.com/containers/buildah/imagebuildah/executor.go:986
```

### Steps to reproduce the issue


1. Start the API service:
   `podman --storage-driver vfs system service --time 0 unix:///tmp/podman.sock &`
2. Pull the images the build uses:
   `podman --remote --url unix:///tmp/podman.sock pull public.ecr.aws/docker/library/{alpine,busybox,debian}`
3. Write this `Containerfile` into an empty directory:
   ```
   FROM localhost/missing AS a
   FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/debian AS b
   COPY --from=public.ecr.aws/docker/library/busybox /bin/busybox /x
   FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/alpine
   COPY --from=a / /a
   COPY --from=b /x /x
   ```
4. Build it through the service:
   `podman --remote --url unix:///tmp/podman.sock build --jobs 3 --pull=never --network none .`



A self-contained script that needs only docker does all of the above in a privileged
container: `PODMAN_VERSION=6.1.3 ./repro.sh`. It exits 1 and prints the panic when it
reproduces. Its source is in the Additional information section below.

### Describe the results you received

The client gets the expected build error, then the service process panics and exits:

```
Error: creating build container: localhost/missing: image not known
```
```
panic: assignment to entry in nil map
go.podman.io/buildah/imagebuildah.(*stageExecutor).getImageRootfs(...)
	vendor/go.podman.io/buildah/imagebuildah/stage_executor.go:1262
```

Reproduced on every version tried, every run:

| podman | package source | crash site |
|---|---|---|
| 5.8.4 | quay.io/podman/stable:v5.8.4 | stage_executor.go:1156 |
| 5.8.7 | quay.io/podman/stable:v5.8.7 (current `latest` there) | stage_executor.go:1156 |
| 5.8.8 | Fedora 43 updates-testing, podman-5.8.8-1.fc43 | stage_executor.go:1156 |
| 6.1.3 | Fedora 45, podman-6.1.3-1.fc45 (buildah 1.45.1) | stage_executor.go:1262 |


### Describe the results you expected

The build fails with `localhost/missing: image not known`, and the service keeps running
and keeps serving other clients.

### podman info output

Podman 6.1.3, reported by the service the build crashed; the hostname is redacted.

### Podman in a container

Yes

### Privileged Or Rootless

Privileged

### Upstream Latest Release

Yes

### Additional environment details

Additional environment det
- Host kernel 7.0.0-38-generic, x86_64, 16 CPUs, 32 GB RAM.
- The outer engine is docker 29.8.1.
- First seen in production with a Docker CLI client (classic builder, `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0`)
  talking to the Docker-compatible endpoint of a rootless podman 5.8.4 service, while
  several builds ran at once.
ails

### Additional information


Cause, read from the 5.8.4 vendored buildah:

- `Executor.Build` returns on the first stage error (`executor.go:1019-1022`) without
  waiting for stage goroutines that are still running.
- Its deferred `cleanup()` sets `b.containerMap = nil` (`executor.go:737`).
- A stage still running then calls `getImageRootfs`, which writes
  `s.executor.containerMap[image] = builder` (`stage_executor.go:1156`).

Notes:

- The same race also crashes with a nil-pointer dereference in
  `getContentSummaryAfterAddingContent` (`stage_executor.go:1164`). The cleanup's
  `stage.Delete()` sets `s.builder = nil` under a stage that is still executing. A
  Containerfile whose running stage is inside a `RUN` when the sibling fails hits that
  variant instead.
- `--jobs` > 1 makes it deterministic. The production crash used the default `jobs=1` on
  the compat `/build` endpoint. There, a stage blocked in `waitForStage` releases the job
  semaphore for 10ms at a time (`executor.go:473-477`), letting the next stage start; under
  load that is enough.
- buildah main still has the unguarded write and the `containerMap = nil` cleanup. It only
  adds `defer cancel(nil)` around the stage results. Not tested.

<details>
<summary>repro.sh</summary>

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Crashes `podman system service` with "panic: assignment to entry in nil map"
# (buildah imagebuildah getImageRootfs): a stage fails, Build's cleanup sets
# containerMap = nil, and a still-running sibling stage then does
# COPY --from=<image> and writes into the nil map.
#
# Needs only docker. The podman under test runs inside a privileged container.
# Usage: ./repro.sh                       (PODMAN_VERSION=5.8.4)
#        PODMAN_VERSION=6.1.3 ./repro.sh  (5.8.4 5.8.7 5.8.8 6.1.3)
# Exit:  1 = crash reproduced, 0 = service survived.
set -euo pipefail

PODMAN_VERSION=${PODMAN_VERSION:-5.8.4}
CONTAINER=podman-repro-$$
SOCKET=unix:///tmp/podman.sock
MIRROR=public.ecr.aws/docker/library   # Docker Hub's official images, no pull rate limit

# quay.io/podman/stable publishes 5.8.4 and 5.8.7; newer ones come from Fedora packages.
case $PODMAN_VERSION in
5.8.4 | 5.8.7) PODMAN_IMAGE=quay.io/podman/stable:v$PODMAN_VERSION ;;
5.8.8) FEDORA_RELEASE=43 FEDORA_REPOS=--enablerepo=updates-testing ;;
6.1.3) FEDORA_RELEASE=45 FEDORA_REPOS= ;;
*) echo "unsupported PODMAN_VERSION=$PODMAN_VERSION" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
if [ -z "${PODMAN_IMAGE:-}" ]; then
	PODMAN_IMAGE=localhost/podman-repro:$PODMAN_VERSION
	docker build -q -t "$PODMAN_IMAGE" - >/dev/null <<EOF
FROM registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:$FEDORA_RELEASE
RUN dnf install -y $FEDORA_REPOS podman-$PODMAN_VERSION && dnf clean all
EOF
fi

# vfs: no nested overlay needed. tmpfs /var/tmp: podman 6 overlays the build context there.
docker run -d --privileged --tmpfs /var/tmp --name "$CONTAINER" "$PODMAN_IMAGE" \
	podman --storage-driver vfs system service --time 0 "$SOCKET" >/dev/null
trap 'docker rm -f "$CONTAINER" >/dev/null' EXIT
podman_remote() { docker exec -i "$CONTAINER" podman --remote --url "$SOCKET" "$@"; }

for _ in $(seq 30); do podman_remote info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
podman_remote version --format 'podman server {{.Server.Version}}'
podman_remote pull -q $MIRROR/alpine $MIRROR/busybox $MIRROR/debian >/dev/null

docker exec -i "$CONTAINER" sh -c 'mkdir /tmp/context && cat >/tmp/context/Containerfile' <<EOF
FROM localhost/missing AS a
FROM $MIRROR/debian AS b
COPY --from=$MIRROR/busybox /bin/busybox /x
FROM $MIRROR/alpine
COPY --from=a / /a
COPY --from=b /x /x
EOF
podman_remote build --jobs 3 --pull=never --network none /tmp/context || true

for _ in $(seq 30); do
	[ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$CONTAINER")" = true ] || break
	sleep 1
done
if docker logs "$CONTAINER" 2>&1 | grep -A40 '^panic:' | grep -E '^panic|^[a-z].*\(|\.go:' |
	grep -v '/runtime/' | head -12; then
	echo "REPRODUCED on podman $PODMAN_VERSION"
	exit 1
fi
podman_remote info --format 'service still alive: podman {{.Version.Version}}'
```
